cli.intro: open-cam - OpenCAM 2.5-axis toolpath and G-code generator (millimetres)
usage: open-cam operation add <file> --id <id> --kind face|contour|pocket|drill|engrave --tool <id> --depth <d> [--stepdown <d>] [--stepover <d>] [--strategy raster|spiral] [--shape rect|circle] [--x <x>] [--y <y>] [--width <w>] [--height <h>] [--holes <x,y;x,y>] [--peck <d>] [--island <x,y,w,h>]... [--path <x,y;x,y>]
cli.exit: Exit codes: 0 success, 1 input/validation error, 2 capability not implemented

error.unknownFormat: unknown export format `{format}`; only gcode, json, csv or md is supported
